text: 673 coordinates the exact ews-rs revision in the Cargo dependency, source replacement and lockfile while updating its vendor checksum. It also changes the time dependency and includes a small XML serialization fix. The substantive namespace change was read rather than discarded because it is in third_party. Generated manifest fields and checksum JSON are provenance, not Thunderbird Rust style examples. Current pins have changed, so the 2024 revision is historical evidence rather than a version to copy.
